required_plan_clarifications.problem: A reviewed operation change may change executor SHA, so earlier upload fresh anchors cannot become the next activation previous observation.
required_plan_clarifications.resolution: Independent upload and activate invocations each verify current clean main and prepare again. Activate validates all existing objects by full GET; previous is only the first fresh observation of the same activation. Historical effects remain evidence, not authorization.

Production CLI hardwires existing fresh/native/client implementations. Test-only shared orchestration is callable only by the test driver, cannot yield production success, and must retain actual native fixture and SDK effect receipts. Test fresh clean checkout with real Git, model remote API only at transport seam. Real public provenance requires actual tuple and tools; do not mark mock-native helpers as passed attestation.

Keep Provider unchanged. Expected exact uploader/activator session ARN and identity type are independently reviewed current-control inputs, never copied from observed identity to make comparison pass. An externally supplied fixed RoleSessionName can make expected session identity pre-specifiable. Actual role/account/session/principal availability remains unknown.

Use canonical origin and a bounded transport-level CNAME destination override; default certificate validation still targets canonical host. Execute proposed loopback TLS contracts later, including server-observed SNI/Host, wrong SAN/CA, redirect, timeout/size, URI/query preservation, and process/server cleanup. No tests run in this review.
